After sailing for <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn></math> seconds, towards the base of the tower (which is at the level of water), the boat has reached a point <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>B</mi></math>, where the angle of depression is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>45</mn><mo>°</mo><mo>.</mo></math> Then the time taken (in seconds) by the boat from <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>B</mi></math> to reach the base of the tower is :
solution:
Let speed of boat is u m/s and height of tower
is h meter & distance AB=x metre

∴x=hcot30°-hcot45°

⇒x=h(3-1)

∴u=x20=h(3-1)20 m/s

∴ Time taken to travel from B to C (Distance
=h meter)

=hu=hh(3-1)20=203-1=10(3+1)sec .

Which of the following points does NOT lie on it?
solution:
Slope of tangent =mT=m

So, m-2=-1⇒m=12

Equation: y=mx+am

⇒ y=12x+32×12   ∵a=64=32

⇒ y=x2+3

⇒ 2y=x+6

Point 5, 4 will not lie on it
